title: Measurement Wheel
description: A straight line through the center of the circle (a diameter) is divided into equal parts and can be rotated to any angle. Each subdivision count is named after a coin.

geometryModel.description: The diameter line is divided into n equal parts.
geometryModel.even: When n is even, one division point falls exactly on the center, and marks (measured from the center outward) land at q = 1, 2, … n/2.
geometryModel.odd: When n is odd, the center sits between two marks instead. The nearest marks sit half a segment off-center, at q = 0.5, 1.5, …
geometryModel.note: Same diameter-division principle applies to every Proportiyn.Penny — only the subdivision count changes.
